# Review CHANGES REQUESTED for PAN-5585

# Review — PAN-5585
## Verdict: CHANGES REQUESTED — CI `test-e2e` is red at f256ecd (new conditional hook in App.tsx breaks the React Compiler skip ratchet), and the PR body is missing the screenshots and the "not verified on a device" statement the issue requires

## Context
- Run ID: agent-pan-5585-review-f256ecd3
- Manifest: /home/eltmon/Projects/overdeck/workspaces/feature-pan-5585/.pan/review/agent-pan-5585-review-f256ecd3/context.json
- Branch / workspace: feature/pan-5585 / /home/eltmon/Projects/overdeck/workspaces/feature-pan-5585
- PR: https://github.com/eltmon/overdeck/pull/5591
- HEAD reviewed: f256ecd327a9d725bb83d3221289f6071004ed40
- Base: merge-base 50294f099f64 (origin/main); no prior review cycle
- Note: while this review ran, the work agent pushed 800c44f411f (raises the App.tsx compiler-skip baseline 47 → 48). That commit is outside the reviewed HEAD; it is discussed under Blocking finding 1 because it is the attempted fix for that finding.

## Blocking Findings

### [correctness] New conditional hook in App.tsx fails the React Compiler skip ratchet; CI `test-e2e` red — `src/dashboard/frontend/src/App.tsx:151`
- Severity: ! (MUST)
- Classification / requirement scope: implementation defect that follows a flawed spec instruction (PRD WI-6 step 4: "Call `useVisualViewportVars();` in the `App` body directly before `const [activeTab…]` … it sits after the route early returns"); in_pr_scope.
- Trigger and changed-code connection: the PR adds `useVisualViewportVars()` after the `/popout/*` and `/m` early returns in `App()`. The React Compiler counts it as one more "Hooks must always be called in a consistent order" diagnostic.
- Expected / observed / impact: CI `test-e2e` (frontend CI subset) fails at f256ecd: `src/__tests__/reactCompilerCoverage.test.ts > the frontend tree matches scripts/react-compiler-skip-baseline.txt` — `App.tsx: 48 skip(s), baseline 47`. The PR cannot merge with a red required job.
- Evidence: job https://github.com/eltmon/overdeck/actions/runs/44970863357/job/137050111807 log ("Test Files 1 failed | 568 passed", the assertion above). `App()` already runs an unconditional `useEffect` at App.tsx line 114, before the early returns.
- Fix: move the `useVisualViewportVars()` call to the top of `App()`, beside the existing unconditional `useEffect` at line 114, before every early return. That adds no compiler skip. On `/m` the hook then runs in both `App` and `MobileApp`, which D-13 already accepts: both write identical values, and cleanup removes only listeners. Leave the baseline at 47. The follow-up commit 800c44f raises the shrink-only baseline instead. docs/DASHBOARD-ARCHITECTURE.md ("React Compiler") allows a hand-edited raise, but it says to fix a conditional hook by "Call hooks unconditionally at the top of the component". Here that fix is one line, so the raise is avoidable. Revert 800c44f's baseline change when you move the call. Spec correction: WI-6 step 4 should say "at the top of `App`, before the route early returns".

### [requirements] PR body has no screenshot links and no "iOS keyboard not verified on a device" statement — PR #5591 body
- Severity: ! (MUST)
- Classification / requirement scope: unmet explicit acceptance criterion; in_pr_scope.
- Trigger and changed-code connection: the PR body lists only the work-item checklist. All boxes are ticked.
- Expected / observed / impact: issue AC "A screenshot of each width is attached to the PR". Issue Fix 4: "If this cannot be verified headless, state that in the PR and verify what can be verified". PRD AC-8: the screenshots are "linked from the PR body". PRD CP-1 fallback: the PR body states "iOS keyboard behavior not verified on a device; verified headless: …". None of this appears in the body or in any comment (the only comment is CodeRabbit's). An operator who reads the PR would assume the iOS keyboard fix was checked on a device. It was not: Playwright WebKit has no software keyboard.
- Evidence: `gh pr view 5591 --json body` (13 lines, no links); `gh pr view 5591 --comments` (CodeRabbit only).
- Fix: PR-body edit only, no code change. Link `docs/screenshots/pan-5585/rail-overlay-393.png`, `rail-overlay-360.png` and `topbar-360.png`. Add the CP-1 statement and list the headless checks: the `visualViewport.test.ts` unit tests, and the spec test "the root follows the visual viewport" (`--app-height` = `innerHeight`, `#root` height = `innerHeight`).

## Non-blocking Findings
- `~` **Doc inaccuracy** — `docs/DASHBOARD-ARCHITECTURE.md` "Phone width (PAN-5585)" says all three menus' wrappers go `max-sm:static` with `left-2 right-2` insets. Only `SystemHealthPill` changed. The Agents and Needs-you menus still rely on `MenuSurface`'s viewport constraint (D-7). Reword the sentence to match the code.
- `~` **Specification defect, composer truncation (issue problem 3)** — D-10 says FR-1 fixes the truncated composer chips. The committed `topbar-360.png` (rail closed, full width) still shows `Clau…`, `T.`, `S.` at 360 px. Nothing overflows, and no issue AC covers it, so this is not a blocker. The PRD's claim is wrong, though, and the issue's problem 3 is only partly addressed. File a follow-up issue if the operator wants readable chips at 360 px.
- `?` **Side effect on the Command Deck terminal header** — the new `@container (max-width: 520px)` rule also matches `ConversationTerminal.tsx` line 59, which uses `.conversationHeaderContainer` + `.conversationTerminalTitle`. At ≤ 520 px its title now takes its own line. This header already wraps (`flex-wrap: wrap`), so the result is benign and arguably better. Noted in case it was not intended.
- `?` **UX: vertical space** — at 360×780 the wrapped conversation header takes about 4 rows, roughly 45 % of the height (rail-overlay screenshots). It meets FR-6. It may be worth a later pass once the composer and keyboard are open on a device.
- `?` **Verification gap (spec decision D-11)** — `pan-5585-phone-width.spec.ts` is not in `test:playwright` and no automated job runs it, because CI installs Chromium only. I did not run it. AC-4, AC-5 and AC-8 rest on the committed screenshots, each taken after that test's assertions. The screenshots are consistent with the assertions: the top bar fits 360 px, Conversation and Terminal are visible, and the overlay leaves the timeline its width.

## Coverage
Changed-file ledger (all reviewed):
- `apps/mobile/src/shell/ShellApp.tsx` — reviewed. Hook plus `app-viewport-shell`. `apps/mobile/src/main.tsx` imports the dashboard `index.css`, and the rule is in `@layer base`, which Tailwind always emits. The `apps/mobile/tailwind.config.js` content globs cover both shells. OK.
- `src/dashboard/frontend/src/App.tsx` — reviewed. Blocking finding 1. The `h-[var(--app-height,100dvh)]` root and `pt-[env(safe-area-inset-top)]` padding are fine: preflight uses border-box.
- `App/AppChrome.tsx`, `topbar/AgentsMenu.tsx`, `topbar/Breadcrumb.tsx`, `flywheel/NeedsYouIndicator.tsx` — reviewed. CSS-only hiding. Text nodes stay in the DOM (NFR-2). The Agents trigger gains `aria-label`. The Needs-you trigger already had an `aria-label`, so its accessible name does not change. Search keeps `title="Search"`.
- `components/SystemHealthPill.tsx` — reviewed. `SystemHealthPill` renders only in `AppChrome`, so `max-sm:static` resolves to the bar, which is `relative`. Outside-click still works because the popover stays a DOM child of `wrapperRef`.
- `chat/SubagentRail.tsx`, `chat/ConversationPanel.tsx` — reviewed. `select` is declared after `narrow`, so the deps array is safe. `hostRef` stays on in-flow elements, so the ResizeObserver still measures the row. The unkeyed top-level fragment reuses the strip button's fiber. The wide-pane branch is unchanged apart from `data-mode`. The persistence key, `defaultCollapsed` and `toggleSignal` are untouched (NonGoal 7).
- `CommandDeck/styles/command-deck.module.css` — reviewed. The two-class selectors outrank the base rules. One side effect noted above.
- `components/mobile/MobileApp.tsx` — reviewed. Uses the class and calls the hook.
- `index.css` — reviewed. `body` and `#root` keep their `100vh` fallbacks. `.app-viewport-shell` is OK.
- `lib/visualViewport.ts` — reviewed. Pinch-zoom guard, floor rounding, listener cleanup. The CSS variables persist after unmount, which is harmless because a longer-lived caller still writes them.
- Tests: `AppChrome.test.tsx`, `AgentsMenu.test.tsx`, `Breadcrumb.test.tsx`, `NeedsYouIndicator.test.tsx`, `SubagentRail.test.tsx`, `visualViewport.test.ts` — reviewed. They assert DOM and classes, not source text. No timers involved.
- `tests/pan-5585-phone-width.spec.ts` — reviewed. Isolated dashboard (NFR-4). Not in CI (D-11).
- Docs: `docs/CONVERSATION-SUBAGENTS.md`, `features/conversations.mdx`, `changelog.d/pan-5585.md` — reviewed, accurate. `docs/DASHBOARD-ARCHITECTURE.md` — reviewed, one inaccuracy (advisory).
- Screenshots (3 PNGs) — `rail-overlay-360.png` and `topbar-360.png` viewed. `rail-overlay-393.png` is present but was not viewed.
- `.pan/continues`, `.pan/drafts`, `.pan/specs` — planning artifacts, read as requirements input. Not applicable for code review.

Dimensions:
- Correctness: one blocker (compiler ratchet). Rail state machine, refs and CSS precedence checked.
- Security: not applicable in substance. Only CSS and layout changes, plus one `visualViewport` read. No new input, network or storage surface.
- Performance: `visualViewport` resize/scroll listeners write two style properties per event, a bounded cost. No new render loops. The scrim and overlay mount only while open.
- Requirements/UX: FR-1 to FR-7 are implemented. The issue's PR-body ACs are unmet (blocker 2). Composer truncation is advisory. The D-6 no-loss check holds: the System-health popover still shows Auto-resume (`DeaconPauseToggle`) and `StoppedAgentsBanner variant="section"`, so the hidden frozen and stopped chips stay reachable on a phone.

AC matrix:
- AC-1 met — the SubagentRail tests pass locally (part of the 76/76 run below).
- AC-2 met — AppChrome and Breadcrumb tests pass.
- AC-3 met — AgentsMenu, NeedsYouIndicator and countAgreement tests pass. The accessible name is checked.
- AC-4 met on screenshot evidence only (`topbar-360.png`; the spec was not run here).
- AC-5 met on screenshot evidence only.
- AC-6 partly met — the unit test passes. The `--app-height` WebKit check rests on the spec author's run.
- AC-7 met — both roots use the class and the hook. The `overdeck/test` gate (typecheck) is green and `mobile-android` passes.
- AC-8 **unmet** — the screenshots are committed but not linked from the PR body (blocker 2).
- AC-9 met, with one doc inaccuracy (advisory). `lint-group (core)` is green.

## Verification
- `cd src/dashboard/frontend && npx vitest run` on the 7 touched or AC-named test files: 7 files, 76 tests passed.
- CI at f256ecd (`gh pr checks 5591`):
  - Passing: build (22), lint-group core, effect, skills and state, all four test shards, mobile-android, and the `overdeck/test` verification gate (typecheck+lint).
  - **Failing: test-e2e** (React Compiler baseline). The aggregate `test` job also fails.
  - `bare-host-linux` was still pending.
- `npm run lint:effect-diagnostics`: covered by the green `lint-group (effect)` at this HEAD.
- The Playwright WebKit spec was not run (not in CI per D-11). Its evidence is the committed screenshots.
- App.tsx is on `eslint-react-compiler-allowlist.json`, which is why ESLint passed. The oxc skip baseline is the authority, and it failed.

## Scope Note
The work agent's follow-up commit 800c44f raises the shrink-only compiler-skip baseline rather than moving one hook call to the top of `App()`. Prefer the one-line move and revert the baseline row to 47.

   - `bash scripts/lint-ratchet-audit.sh` → "ratchet audit passed".

   I downgrade this to an advisory (see below).

## Blocking Findings

### [requirements] PR body has no screenshot links and no "iOS keyboard not verified on a device" statement — PR #5591 body
- Severity: ! (MUST)
- Classification / requirement scope: unmet explicit acceptance criterion; in_pr_scope.
- Trigger and changed-code connection: the PR body lists only the ticked work-item checklist.
- Expected / observed / impact: the issue requires these items, and the PR does not provide them:
  - Issue AC: "A screenshot of each width is attached to the PR".
  - Issue Fix 4: "If this cannot be verified headless, state that in the PR and verify what can be verified".
  - PRD AC-8: the screenshots are "linked from the PR body".
  - PRD CP-1 fallback: the PR body says "iOS keyboard behavior not verified on a device; verified headless: …".

  An operator who merges from this PR would assume the iOS keyboard fix was checked on a device. Playwright WebKit has no software keyboard, so it was not.
- Evidence: `gh pr view 5591 --json body` at 800c44f (same 13 lines as the prior cycle). The only PR comment is CodeRabbit's.
- Fix: PR-body edit only (`gh pr edit 5591 --body-file …`), no code change:
  - Link `docs/screenshots/pan-5585/rail-overlay-393.png`, `rail-overlay-360.png` and `topbar-360.png` (blob URLs on the branch).
  - Add: "iOS keyboard behavior not verified on a device; verified headless: `visualViewport.test.ts` (variables set and updated, pinch-zoom removes them), and the WebKit spec test 'the root follows the visual viewport' (`--app-height` = `innerHeight`, `#root` height = `innerHeight`)."

## Non-blocking Findings
- `≉` **Baseline raise where a one-line fix exists** — `src/dashboard/frontend/src/App.tsx` line 151. Two things would remove the skip instead of raising the shrink-only row:
  - Move `useVisualViewportVars()` to the top of `App()`, beside the unconditional `useEffect` at line 114.
  - Revert the row to 47.

  The 800c44f commit message says restructuring App's routing is out of scope. Only this one new call needs to move, not the existing hooks. D-13 already accepts double callers on `/m`. The raise is permitted by policy, so this is advisory.
- `~` **Doc inaccuracy** — `docs/DASHBOARD-ARCHITECTURE.md` "Phone width (PAN-5585)" says all three menus' wrappers go `max-sm:static` with `left-2 right-2`. Only `SystemHealthPill` changed. The Agents and Needs-you menus rely on `MenuSurface` (D-7).
- `~` **Specification defect, composer truncation (issue problem 3)** — `topbar-360.png` (rail closed) still shows `Clau…`, `T.`, `S.` at 360 px. D-10's premise that FR-1 fixes this does not hold at 360 px. No AC covers it, and nothing overflows. A follow-up issue is the right home.
- `?` **Side effect** — the new `@container (max-width: 520px)` rule also matches the Command Deck `ConversationTerminal.tsx` line 59 header (title on its own line at ≤ 520 px). That header already wraps, so the change is benign.
- `?` **UX** — at 360×780 the wrapped conversation header takes about 45 % of the height.
- `?` **Verification gap (spec decision D-11)** — the WebKit spec runs in no automated job, and I did not run it. AC-4, AC-5 and AC-8 rest on the committed screenshots.

## Coverage
- Changed source, tests and docs are identical to the prior cycle, and all were reviewed there. The full changed-file ledger is in `.pan/review/agent-pan-5585-review-f256ecd3/review.md`, "Coverage".
  - `apps/mobile/src/shell/ShellApp.tsx` (HIGH): the class is defined in `@layer base` of the dashboard `index.css`, which `apps/mobile/src/main.tsx` imports, so it is always emitted. The hook is called.
  - `SubagentRail.tsx`: ref and state flow verified.
  - CSS precedence verified.
  - `SystemHealthPill`: only one caller (`AppChrome`).
- New in this cycle:
  - `scripts/react-compiler-skip-baseline.txt`: reviewed. The raise has an issue-named commit, and the audit passes.
  - `.pan/continues/PAN-5585.xbrief.json`: planning state, not applicable.
- Dimensions:
  - Correctness: no open defect.
  - Security: not applicable (CSS and layout changes plus one `visualViewport` read).
  - Performance: bounded listener writes, no new render loops.
  - Requirements/UX: one blocker (PR body). D-6 no-loss holds: the health popover still holds the Auto-resume and Stopped-agents sections.
- AC matrix:
  - AC-1, AC-2, AC-3: met (unit tests 76/76 in the prior cycle; source unchanged).
  - AC-4, AC-5: met on screenshot evidence.
  - AC-6: unit test met; the WebKit check rests on the author's run.
  - AC-7: met (`overdeck/test` typecheck gate green; `mobile-android` pass).
  - AC-8: **unmet** (PR-body links).
  - AC-9: met, with one doc inaccuracy.

## Verification

- `bash scripts/lint-ratchet-audit.sh` at 800c44f: passed.
- Focused frontend vitest (7 files, 76 tests), from the prior cycle: passed. The tested source is unchanged.
